schema.description: The agent that the server made. A personal agent has `token`. A workspace agent has no `token`.

id.description: The user id of the agent.

items.description: `read` reads the board. `write` files, updates, comments and closes. `delete` removes records.
items.title: AgentScope

lastUsedAt.description: Always null for a new agent.

token.description: The token of a personal agent, for example `tg_pat_…`. Vantik shows it this one time only. Keep it in a safe place.

schema.title: AgentAccount

401.description: The request has no valid token or session.

403.description: You asked for a workspace agent, and you are not a workspace admin.
